# QQ Music Songs, Artists, Charts and Comments Scraper

QQ Music (QQ音乐), run by Tencent, is one of the largest recorded-music catalogs in mainland China. This actor turns a keyword, song link, artist page, album, playlist or chart into structured records: track metadata, singer credits, album art, audio-quality sizes, chart positions, artist bios and real listener comments. It reads QQ Music's public web endpoints and needs no QQ account, cookie or API key.

## What you can collect

- **Search** songs, artists, albums or playlists with one keyword and paginate through the result set.
- **Songs** from one or many URLs or bare MIDs, with optional LRC lyric excerpt and comment count.
- **Artists** with bio, follower count, total songs/albums/MVs, the full paged song catalog in popularity or newest-first order, and optional album summaries.
- **Albums** with release date, label, genre, language, description and the complete track list, by numeric ID, album MID or URL.
- **Playlists** with owner, cover, listeners, tags, description and the complete track list, by ID or URL.
- **Charts** — one chart with its ranked tracks, or the full chart index. Chart songs carry `chartId`, `chartRank` and rank movement when QQ Music publishes it.
- **Comments** — newest-first or most-liked-first, with author, avatar, text, like count, reply count and optional nested replies. `commentsSince` makes scheduled incremental pulls practical.
- **Typed output** — every row has a `recordType`, and every field QQ Music does not provide is omitted instead of being emitted as `null` or an empty string.

## Modes

| Mode | What it does | Main target fields |
|---|---|---|
| `search` | Search one entity type | `searchQuery`, `searchType` |
| `bySongUrl` | Full song record(s) | `songUrls`, `songMids` |
| `byAlbum` | Album summary + tracks | `albumId`, `albumUrls` |
| `byPlaylist` | Playlist summary + tracks | `playlistId`, `playlistUrls` |
| `byArtist` | Artist summary + song catalog + optional albums | `artistMid`, `artistUrls` |
| `byToplist` | One chart summary + ranked tracks | `toplistId`, `toplistUrls` |
| `toplists` | Index of every current chart with a top-3 preview | — |
| `comments` | Comment rows for one or more songs | `songUrls`, `songMids` |

`toplistId`, `name`, `titleDetail`, `period`, `updateTime`, `listenCount`, `totalTrackCount`, `coverUrl`, `description`, `topSongs[]`, `sourceUrl`, `scrapedAt`, `recordType`.

`commentId`, `nick`, `content`, `praiseCount`, `replyCount`, `publishedAtSec`, `publishedAt`, `avatarUrl`, `songMid`, `songId`, `songName`, `sort`, `isHot` (hot order only), `replies[]` (optional), `sourceUrl`, `scrapedAt`, `recordType`.

`errorCode` (`BAD_URL`, `NOT_FOUND` or `INVALID_INPUT`), `errorMessage`, `inputValue`, `scrapedAt`, `recordType`. A malformed or missing reference is reported, never silently skipped.

## Input

Every input is optional except `mode`; each mode reads only the fields relevant to it.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `search` | What to fetch: `search`, `bySongUrl`, `byAlbum`, `byPlaylist`, `byArtist`, `byToplist`, `toplists` or `comments`. |
| `searchQuery` | string | `周杰伦` | Keyword for `search`. |
| `searchType` | string | `songs` | `songs`, `artists`, `albums` or `playlists`. |
| `songUrls` | array | `[]` | Song URLs for `bySongUrl` or `comments`. |
| `songMids` | array | `[]` | Bare song MIDs for `bySongUrl` or `comments`. |
| `includeLyric` | boolean | `false` | Attach a 2,000-character LRC excerpt in `bySongUrl`. |
| `includeCommentCount` | boolean | `false` | Add `commentCount` to every song record; one extra request per song. |
| `albumId` | integer | – | Numeric album ID for `byAlbum`. |
| `albumUrls` | array | `[]` | Album URLs or MIDs for `byAlbum`. |
| `playlistId` | string | – | Numeric playlist ID for `byPlaylist`. |
| `playlistUrls` | array | `[]` | Playlist URLs or IDs for `byPlaylist`. |
| `artistMid` | string | – | Artist MID or profile URL for `byArtist`. |
| `artistUrls` | array | `[]` | More artist URLs or MIDs for `byArtist`. |
| `artistSongOrder` | string | `popularity` | `popularity` or `latest` song catalog order. |
| `includeArtistInfo` | boolean | `true` | Emit the artist profile record before songs. |
| `includeArtistAlbums` | boolean | `false` | Emit album summaries for the artist. |
| `toplistId` | string | – | Chart ID for `byToplist`, e.g. `26`. |
| `toplistUrls` | array | `[]` | Chart URLs or IDs for `byToplist`. |
| `includeToplistInfo` | boolean | `true` | Emit the chart summary before its tracks. |
| `commentSort` | string | `newest` | `newest` or `hot` for `comments`. |
| `maxCommentsPerSong` | integer | `50` | Comment cap per song, 1–500. |
| `commentsSince` | string | – | ISO date/time; older comments are skipped. |
| `includeCommentReplies` | boolean | `false` | Attach up to 10 nested replies per comment. |
| `minDurationSec` | integer | – | Drop shorter song records. |
| `maxDurationSec` | integer | – | Drop longer song records. |
| `containsKeyword` | string | – | Keep song records whose title contains this text. |
| `singerKeyword` | string | – | Keep song records whose singers contain this text. |
| `maxItems` | integer | `30` | Hard cap on all emitted records, 1–10,000. |

## Examples

Search songs:

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "searchQuery": "周杰伦",
  "searchType": "songs",
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

Search playlists:

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "searchQuery": "华语 经典",
  "searchType": "playlists",
  "maxItems": 20
}
```

Full artist catalog plus album summaries:

```json
{
  "mode": "byArtist",
  "artistMid": "0025NhlN2yWrP4",
  "artistSongOrder": "popularity",
  "includeArtistInfo": true,
  "includeArtistAlbums": true,
  "maxItems": 120
}
```

Newest comments for a song:

```json
{
  "mode": "comments",
  "songMids": ["001Bbywq2gicae"],
  "commentSort": "newest",
  "maxCommentsPerSong": 100,
  "includeCommentReplies": true
}
```

One chart with its ranked tracks:

```json
{
  "mode": "byToplist",
  "toplistId": "26",
  "includeToplistInfo": true,
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

Every chart in the index:

```json
{
  "mode": "toplists",
  "maxItems": 40
}
```

## How pagination works

Search follows QQ Music's own `nextpage` cursor up to the source ceiling (about 1,000 song results for a keyword). Artist songs are paged 30 at a time until the catalog total. Album tracks are paged up to 300 per request; playlists up to 100 per request. Charts expose up to 300 tracks for the daily hot chart and 100 for most others. Comment pages are 25 rows and continue with the source's continuation token. The actor stops at `maxItems`, at source exhaustion, or when repeated empty pages show there is nothing else to take — it does not stop on a wall-clock budget.

## Limits

- Keyword search stops at about 1,000 rows per query. Split the keyword, use an artist catalog, or pull a chart for larger sets.
- Comments are capped at 2,000 per song (`maxCommentsPerSong`); the default is 50. The newest cursor chain was verified at 600 unique comments in a local actor run. Use `commentsSince` with `commentSort: "newest"` for ongoing monitoring.
- Charts are source-sized: most have 100 rows and the daily hot chart can have up to 300. `toplists` lists every current chart.
- Private or empty playlists can expose their title, owner and cover but no public track list; only the summary record is emitted.
- Audio files and playback URLs are not collected. The actor returns metadata, charts, lyric excerpts and comments.
- Typed artist or album search can fall back to two real smartbox rows when the primary search endpoint is unavailable; use `byArtist` or `byAlbum` when you need the complete set.

## Use cases

- Build a Mandarin-pop catalog snapshot with singers, albums, durations and release dates.
- Track daily chart positions and rank movement for playlists, radio or A&R dashboards.
- Export listener comments for sentiment analysis, lyric feedback or community research.
- Enrich an existing music database with QQ Music IDs, cover art and quality tiers.
- Monitor an artist's output and album releases on a schedule.

## Data source and reliability

All data comes from QQ Music's public web JSON endpoints (`y.qq.com` / `c.y.qq.com` / `u.y.qq.com` routes the website itself uses). The actor starts direct, retries temporary errors with backoff, and can automatically switch to an Apify datacenter proxy if a request is rate-limited. No login, cookie, password or API key is used, requested or stored.

## FAQ

**Do I need a QQ Music account?**
No. Every record type is built from publicly readable catalog, chart, lyric and comment data.

**Why did a search return fewer rows than `maxItems`?**
Search is capped by the source, not by the actor. QQ Music serves at most about 1,000 song search results per keyword; use a narrower keyword, an artist catalog or a chart for larger sets. Comment threads are also capped per song by the public API, so `maxCommentsPerSong` has a practical ceiling too.

**Why are some song fields missing?**
QQ Music does not publish every field for every track. For example, an unreleased or instrumental track may have no lyric, an old track may have no FLAC size, and some playlist tracks have no release date. Omit-empty output means the field is simply absent rather than `null`.

**Can I get every comment on a very popular song?**
No public client can export an entire popular thread. QQ Music paginates comments and applies rate limits; the actor follows the newest cursor up to 2,000 per song (default 50). Use `commentsSince` with `commentSort: "newest"` for scheduled runs that only need what is new.

**What do `payPlay`, `payDownload` and `payStatus` mean?**
They are QQ Music's own flags for whether streaming or downloading needs a paid plan. The actor reports the flags; it does not download audio.

**Why do album search results and album detail records differ?**
Search rows carry the summary QQ Music shows in search; the same album in `byAlbum` mode is fetched from the album endpoint and carries more detail plus its track list.

**Are chart ranks comparable across charts?**
No. Each chart has its own ranking rule and size. Use `byToplist` or `toplists` and compare songs within one chart; `chartRankChange` is only present when QQ Music publishes a previous position.

**Is this affiliated with Tencent or QQ Music?**
No. This is an independent data tool that reads publicly available web endpoints; it is not operated by or affiliated with Tencent or QQ Music.
